partnership_announcements.description: Veho and Racklify formed a new commercial partnership under which Veho’s last-mile delivery network is now listed and discoverable on Racklify’s 3PL and warehouse marketplace, giving brands access to Veho when selecting fulfillment partners and enabling Veho clients to tap Racklify’s provider network.

press_references.value: ShipStation® Customers Can Now Leverage Veho's Customer-Centric Delivery Service Across 56 US Markets

partnership_announcements.description: Veho and ShipStation announced a new integration enabling ShipStation merchants to use Veho’s customer-centric delivery service across 56 U.S. markets.

press_references.value: Veho and Enveyo Integration Enables Enterprise Shippers and 3PLs to Easily Diversify Last Mile Delivery

partnership_announcements.description: Veho and Enveyo announced a new technical integration partnership, enabling Enveyo customers to access Veho's last-mile delivery services directly through Enveyo's platform, enhancing delivery options for enterprise shippers and 3PLs.

press_references.value: Veho and RIVR Partner to Improve E-Commerce Delivery Through AI-Powered Robots

partnership_announcements.description: Veho and RIVR have announced a new partnership to deploy AI-powered delivery robots for e-commerce deliveries, starting with a launch in Austin, Texas, and plans to expand to additional markets later in the year. The collaboration aims to improve delivery efficiency and customer experience by pairing human drivers with robots for last-mile delivery.

press_references.value: Veho and Shippo Now Offer 2-5 Day Delivery to 300,000 E-Commerce Brands

partnership_announcements.description: Veho and Shippo have announced a partnership to offer 2-5 day delivery services to over 300,000 e-commerce brands. This collaboration aims to provide a cost-competitive alternative to traditional carriers, enhancing delivery reliability and experience for medium-sized e-commerce brands using Shippo.

press_references.value: Veho and ShipWise Partner to Improve E-commerce Delivery Experience

partnership_announcements.description: Veho and ShipWise announced a partnership to enhance e-commerce delivery, allowing ShipWise's retailers to use Veho's network for improved delivery services.

about_short_description.short_description: Veho provides technology-enabled parcel delivery and logistics services for ecommerce brands.

product.name: Parcel Delivery
product.description: Technology-enabled parcel delivery for ecommerce brands, with next-day and two-day options, transparent pricing, shipment visibility, and delivery support.

product.name: Last Mile Delivery
product.description: Final-mile delivery from local facilities to consumers, supported by route operations, shipment tracking, proof of delivery, and customer support.

product.name: Transportation Solutions
product.description: Middle-mile and parcel transportation services connecting warehouses, sortation facilities, and delivery networks through pickup, direct injection, and customized logistics programs.

product.name: Tech-Powered Parcel Shipping for 3PLs
product.description: Parcel shipping services for third-party logistics providers, including API connectivity, pre-built integrations, shipment visibility, and scalable delivery capacity.

product.name: Premium Economy
product.description: A named Veho delivery service offering positioned as a shipping option for ecommerce brands requiring a defined service level and delivery experience.

product.name: Doorstep Pickup
product.description: A pickup service that coordinates parcel collection at a customer’s doorstep as part of Veho’s delivery and returns operations.
